title: Care Package That Says Everything You Can’t
summary: The best care packages say you're thinking of someone better than words can. Here are the top food care packages that ship nationwide on Goldbelly in 2026.
body_markdown:
Published on September 3rd, 2026


## Because sometimes the best thing you can say is: I sent you something good


A care package is one of those gifts that works for almost any reason. Someone is stressed at work. A kid is homesick at college. A friend is under the weather. Someone you love lives too far away and you just miss them. Whatever the reason, a box of great food says you’re thinking of them better than a text ever could.


Every care package below ships nationwide on Goldbelly, straight from the maker to their door.


[Browse All Care Packages on Goldbelly](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/care-packages)


## **The Best Food Care Packages to Send in 2026**


### **Pike Place Chowder New England Clam Chowder Gift Set**


Pike Place Fish Market has been a Seattle institution since 1930, and Pike Place Chowder has been feeding the crowds ever since. This gift set includes a quart of their award-winning New England Clam Chowder — rich, creamy, and deeply comforting — along with two Pike Place mugs. It’s the kind of thing that warms someone up from the inside out.


**[Order Pike Place Chowder Gift Set](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/pike-place-chowder/new-england-clam-chowder-gift-set-1-quart-2-mugs)**


### **Factor’s Famous Deli Homemade Chicken Soup**


Since 1948, Factor’s Famous Deli has been one of Los Angeles’ most beloved Jewish delis. Their Homemade Chicken Soup tastes like the kind grandmothers have been making for generations: rich, restorative broth with handmade matzo balls and kreplach dumplings. The universally right thing to send.


**[Order Factor’s Famous Deli Chicken Soup](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/factors-famous-deli/get-well-homemade-chicken-soup)**


### **Zucker’s Bagels New York Bagel Brunch**


A New York City staple for nearly 20 years, Zucker’s hand-rolls, kettle-boils, and bakes their bagels using natural flours and ingredients. This brunch kit includes a dozen bagels, housemade granola, smoked fish, coffee, and all the fixings. It’s a full New York morning, shipped to wherever they are.


**[Order Zucker’s Bagel Brunch Box](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/zuckers-bagels-and-smoked-fish/biggest-holiday-bagel-brunch-for-12)**


### **Doan’s Bakery White Chocolate Coconut Bundt Cake**


The cake Tom Cruise sends to his A-list friends every Christmas is available to everyone on Goldbelly. Doan’s Bakery in Woodland Hills, California makes this moist coconut Bundt cake studded with white chocolate chunks, frosted with cream cheese, and buried in toasted coconut flakes. When you want to send something genuinely memorable, this is it.


**[Order Doan’s Bakery White Chocolate Coconut Bundt Cake](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/doans-bakery/white-chocolate-coconut-bundt-cake)**


### **Bread and Roses Dessert Bar Care Package**


Maine’s Bread and Roses Bakery’s Dessert Bar Care Package is made for snacking. The package contains handmade lemon bars, fudge brownies, blueberry crumble bars, Chocolate Oaties, and Magic Bars. A proper assortment for someone who needs a little sweetness in their day.


**[Order Bread and Roses Dessert Bar Care Package](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/bread-and-roses-bakery/dessert-bar-care-package)**


### **Carol’s Cookies Mini Cookie Gift Box**


Over 20 years, Carol Goldman perfected her signature chocolate chip and oatmeal raisin cookie recipes. In 1983, People Magazine named them America’s fourth-best cookies, and the recipes haven’t changed since. This gift box comes with chocolate chip, oatmeal raisin, and sugar cookies in Carol’s signature packaging. Simple, perfect, and always appreciated.


**[Order Carol’s Cookies Mini Cookie Gift Box](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/carols-cookies/carols-cookies-mini-cookie-gift-box-30-pack)**


### **Goldbelly Gift Card**


When you want to let them choose exactly what they’re craving, a Goldbelly Gift Card gives them access to 850+ of America’s best food makers shipped nationwide. Available as an e-gift (delivered instantly) or a physical card.
